{{Quote|I have learned more about the scum who betrayed my clan. Tayari Rook claims he has earned the title Mandalorian. But I heard nothing of him passing the trials of strength and courage required to join a clan.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:TToTR" />}}
'''Tayari Rook''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He claimed to be a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and commanded a band of criminals posing as a Mandalorian clan, the so-called [[Clan Rook/Legends|Clan Rook]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tayari Rook claims to lead his own clan! He destroyed my clan with his slander, then dares to raise up his mishmash of slavers and pirates and call them 'Clan Rook'! And no one has challenged them!|Akaavi Spar|<ref name="TOR:CR" />}}
Around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Tayari Rook claimed that he was a Mandalorian,<ref name="TOR:TToTR" /> but the truth was that Tayari used the Mandalorians' reputation for his criminal business. Tayari created a personal clan, [[Clan Rook/Legends|Clan Rook]], and they operated as a clan of Mandalorians by killing or dishonoring any who would expose the truth of their organization to the true Mandalorians,<ref name="TOR:CR" /> who would be honor-bound to kill the pretenders.<ref name="TOR:TToTR" />

Tayari Rook was also responsible for the downfall of [[Clan Spar]], a real Mandalorian clan that Rook slandered in order to gain a favorable contract with the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR:CR" /> Tayari claimed that Clan Spar had gone back on a contract to destroy [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Rook managed to convince [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stanwu]], an Imperial liaison officer between the Empire and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and Stanwu transmitted the false information to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] who signed the execution order. The Empire decimated Clan Spar, the only survivor being a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Mandalorian by the name of [[Akaavi Spar]].<ref name="TOR:IV">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Imperial Vendetta}}</ref>

Members of the Mandalorian [[Clan Lone]] joined with Clan Rook after they were dishonored for not aiding Clan Spar when the Empire came to capture and execute them. Akaavi Spar eventually learned of Tayari Rook's involvement in the death of her people. She tracked the group to the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where they were camped, working jobs for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and attacked, killing Tayari and any member of Clan Rook that didn't escape her assault.<ref name="TOR:CR" />
